column1: # The XMP properties PDF/A accepts without an extension schema, and the value types of their structures.
# PDF/A-1: the schemas of the XMP Specification (Adobe, January 2004), ISO 19005-1:2005, 6.7.9 and 6.7.11.
# PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3: the schemas of the XMP Specification (Adobe, September 2005), ISO 19005-2:2011, 6.6.2.3.1 and 6.6.4.
# The set matches the one veraPDF 1.30 checks, so both agree on which properties need an extension schema.
# parts: 1 = PDF/A-1; 2 = PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3; 12 = both.
